lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Fixed the WARNING the reviewer flagged inside US-001's own acceptanceCriteria array in prd.json: criteria 4, 5, 7, 10 and 11 (the 'cites all three precedents', 'covers BOTH authoring surfaces', 'back-references adjacent precedent bullets', and the two HOUSE STYLE bullets) all shared the same unguarded-empty-`L` construct as the two CRITICAL oracles fixed by US-R1-001, and only went RED on unmodified main incidentally (whole-file grep degrading to a chance miss of a probed token, not an actual single-line-assertion failure). Added `test -n "$L" &&` before every `sed -n "${L}p"`/`! sed -n "${L}p"` read in those 5 criteria, same one-line fix pattern as US-R1-001, and updated each criterion's leading annotation to say 'guarded fail-closed on an empty anchor' for consistency with the already-fixed criteria 6 and 9. Verified by hand: all 5 oracles now GREEN on HEAD (L resolves to 899) and genuinely RED on unmodified main (verified via a `git show main:scripts/cam/patterns.md` temp-tree re-run of each oracle verbatim, all exit 1). Diff is scoped to prd.json only (5 lines changed), matching US-R1-001's doc-only scope. Both round-1 reviewer findings (the CRITICAL and this WARNING) are now addressed; nothing else outstanding from review-artifact.txt is known to remain unaddressed as of this story.
